key_finding: UMCSENT 3-month momentum (S3_mom) with a rolling z-score > +1.0 trigger, 6-month lead, and P1 Long/Cash sizing delivers OOS Sharpe 1.16, 7.95% annualized return, and max drawdown -0.70% for XLV.
mechanism: Hypothesis: rising UMCSENT 3-month momentum signals improving household confidence and risk appetite, which can support XLV over the next roughly 6 months even though health care is a partly defensive sector.
caveats: The indicator-level evidence was not regenerated in the winner refresh; existing lead-lag and regime diagnostics remain the correct context for interpretation.
The corrected winner is specific to UMCSENT 3-month momentum with a rolling z-score > +1.0 trigger and 6-month lead; it should not be generalized to the UMCSENT level or year-over-year change.
The result is primarily a drawdown-control finding: OOS annual return trails XLV buy-and-hold, while max drawdown improves materially.
narrative_summary: UMCSENT 3-month momentum, lagged 6 months and triggered only when its rolling z-score is above +1.0, is a procyclical XLV timing signal in the corrected tournament output. The winner posts OOS Sharpe 1.16, +7.95% annual return, and -0.70% max drawdown, so the story is mainly drawdown control rather than return maximization.
